exposure: prenatal antibiotic exposure (by trimester of pregnancy)
prenatal antibiotic exposure (by number of courses)
prenatal antibiotic exposure (by type of antibiotics)
outcome: infant age- and sex-specific weight-for-length z score (WFL-z)
cohort: The study included 454 infants recruited between 2013 and 2015 in North Carolina, United States.
finding: Prenatal antibiotic exposure in the second trimester was associated with an altered infant gut microbiome composition at 3 and 12 months and with higher infant WFL-z and subscapular skinfold thickness at 12 months.
mod_finding: After adjustment for delivery method, only second-trimester antibiotic exposure remained significantly associated with higher infant WFL-z and subscapular skinfold thickness.
